SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.item_code AS item_code, i.item_name AS item_name, i.unit AS unit, i.min_stock AS min_stock, COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0) AS "totalQty", COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity - s.pre_allocated_qty), 0) AS "availableQty" FROM item i LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE i.min_stock IS NOT NULL
AND i.id = #{query.itemId}
AND (i.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.itemKeyword}, '%') OR i.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.itemKeyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY i.id, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.unit, i.min_stock HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity - s.pre_allocated_qty), 0) < i.min_stock ORDER BY i.id ASC
